final: WITH fee_order_join AS (SELECT f.feerate, f.rebrate, o.recordvault, o.timespan FROM fees f INNER JOIN orders o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault), group_stats AS (SELECT timespan, AVG(CASE WHEN feerate IS NOT NULL AND feerate != 0 THEN rebrate / feerate ELSE NULL END) as avg_ratio, COUNT(DISTINCT recordvault) as distinct_order_count FROM fee_order_join GROUP BY timespan), cross_group_avg AS (SELECT AVG(distinct_order_count) as avg_count FROM group_stats), filtered_groups AS (SELECT gs.avg_ratio, gs.distinct_order_count, cga.avg_count FROM group_stats gs CROSS JOIN cross_group_avg cga WHERE gs.distinct_order_count > cga.avg_count) SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) as avg_of_avg_ratios, SUM(distinct_order_count) as sum_of_distinct_counts, AVG(distinct_order_count - avg_count) as avg_excess_count FROM filtered_groups
